name: order_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the order. Primary key.

name: event_id
description: UUID analytics event ID for cross-joining with events table

name: user_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the purchasing user

name: anonymous_id
description: Anonymous identifier at time of purchase (for guest checkouts)

name: order_date
description: Timestamp when the order was created. Partition field.

name: revenue
description: Order total (revenue attributed to this channel/campaign)

name: currency
description: 3-letter ISO currency code (e.g. USD, GBP, NGN)

name: source
description: Attribution source at time of purchase

name: medium
description: Attribution medium at time of purchase

name: campaign
description: UTM campaign at time of purchase

name: confidence_score
description: Attribution confidence score 0.0–1.0 at time of purchase

name: confidence_level
description: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW at time of purchase

name: is_reconstructed
description: True if attribution was inferred rather than directly captured

name: reconstruction_rule
description: Name of reconstruction rule used (when is_reconstructed=true)

name: gclid
description: Google click ID present at time of purchase

name: fbclid
description: Facebook click ID present at time of purchase

name: ttclid
description: TikTok click ID present at time of purchase

name: has_coupon
description: True if a discount code was applied to this order

name: coupon_code
description: Discount code applied (null if no discount)

name: item_count
description: Number of line items in the order
